ALGO.description: Compression algorithm to use for zram (e.g., lz4, zstd). The default config ships with 'lz4'. The comment notes that availability depends on the kernel. Valid values typically include 'lz4', 'zstd', etc., but the template only substitutes the value directly. The existing schema enum is noted but the template simply uses {{ ALGO }}.

PERCENT.description: Percentage of total RAM to use for zram swap. Takes precedence over SIZE. The config uses this as an integer value directly in the assignment.

SIZE.description: Static amount of RAM (in MiB) to use for zram devices. Ignored if PERCENT is set. The config uses this as an integer value directly in the assignment.

PRIORITY.description: Priority for the zram swap devices. Higher number means higher priority. The config uses this as an integer value directly in the assignment.
